layout.body:
To : All Customers
From: The Team at Municipal Charter
Date: May 31
SUBJECT：Important: Go Paperless with Your Municipal Charter Account!
Dear Valued Customer,
Make your banking easier and safer! Enroll in paperless billing for your Municipal Charter savings account.
Why choose paperless billing?
Get statements faster: Receive your monthly savings account statement as a PDF document by email.
It's convenient: Access your statement anytime on your computer, tablet, or phone.
Help the environment: Reduce paper waste.
How to enroll:
Open the Municipal Charter mobile app on your phone.
Log in to your account.
Go to Account Preferences (usually in the upper right corner).
Select the option for Paperless Billing or Electronic Statements.
Follow the simple steps to complete enrollment.
Enroll today! It’s quick, easy, and secure.
Sincerely,
The Team at Municipal Charter
customerservice@municipalcharter.example.com
